panels.title: Installs today (UTC)
panels.description: Distinct install ids that sent an install event since 00:00 UTC today, read live from the events table (the rollup panels below lag one day).

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs_today FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs_today FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000

panels.title: Heartbeats today (UTC)
panels.description: Heartbeat events received since 00:00 UTC today: installs that were used again after their first report.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS heartbeats_today FROM events WHERE event = 'heartbeat' AND received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS heartbeats_today FROM events WHERE event = 'heartbeat' AND received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000

panels.title: Platforms today
panels.description: Distinct installs seen today by operating system, live from the events table.

targets.queryText: SELECT os, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 GROUP BY os ORDER BY installs DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT os, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 GROUP BY os ORDER BY installs DESC

panels.title: Installs per hour (last 48 h)
panels.description: New install events per UTC hour over the last 48 hours, live from the events table.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 172800) * 1000000000 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 172800) * 1000000000 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour ASC

panels.title: Unique installs per month (12 months)
panels.description: Distinct install ids active in each of the last 12 calendar months: live from the events table for the retention window, from rollups_daily.active_install beyond it. Matches GET /v1/summary's installs_per_month.

targets.queryText: SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS unique_installs FROM (SELECT substr(day,1,7) AS month, key AS id FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' AND day < date('now', '-89 day') UNION SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS month, install_id AS id FROM events WHERE received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now', '-89 day')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS unique_installs FROM (SELECT substr(day,1,7) AS month, key AS id FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' AND day < date('now', '-89 day') UNION SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS month, install_id AS id FROM events WHERE received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now', '-89 day')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Weekly active installs (12 weeks)
panels.description: Distinct install ids active per week, from rollups_daily.active_install. Uses SQLite's strftime('%W') (Monday-based week-of-year); this can disagree with the API's ISO week numbering right at a year boundary, so treat this as a trend view rather than a byte-for-byte match to /v1/summary.

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS active_installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 7776000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS active_installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 7776000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Agent distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per agent over the trailing 30 rolled-up days: an install active on 10 different days contributes 10, once per day it reported that agent. Not distinct installs. Matches GET /v1/summary's agent_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT je.value AS agent, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.agents_json) je WHERE e.received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY installs DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT je.value AS agent, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.agents_json) je WHERE e.received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY installs DESC

panels.title: Component distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per component over the trailing 30 rolled-up days, same install-days semantics as agent distribution. Matches GET /v1/summary's component_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT je.value AS component, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.components_json) je WHERE e.received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY component ORDER BY installs DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT je.value AS component, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.components_json) je WHERE e.received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY component ORDER BY installs DESC

panels.title: RDD enabled ratio (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Share of install-days over the trailing 30 rolled-up days reporting rdd_enabled=true. Matches GET /v1/summary's rdd_enabled_ratio.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(rdd) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rdd_enabled_ratio FROM (SELECT install_id, MAX(rdd_enabled) AS rdd FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY install_id)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(rdd) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rdd_enabled_ratio FROM (SELECT install_id, MAX(rdd_enabled) AS rdd FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY install_id)

panels.title: Version distribution (trailing 30 days)
panels.description: Install-days per reported version over the trailing 30 rolled-up days. A useful proxy for upgrade lag. Matches GET /v1/summary's version_distribution.

targets.queryText: SELECT version, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY version ORDER BY installs DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT version, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000) * 1000000000 GROUP BY version ORDER BY installs DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Events per day
panels.description: Raw event volume (install + heartbeat), bounded by --retention-days: older raw rows are purged, so this panel only ever shows the retention window, unlike the rollup-backed panels above which cover full history.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM events GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM events GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

panels.title: npm downloads per day (gentle-pi, gentle-engram)
panels.description: Daily download counts from the npm registry's public API (api.npmjs.org) — a public count, not telemetry from any gentle-ai install. Matches GET /v1/summary's downloads.npm. The gentle_pi and gentle_engram columns mirror the collector's default --npm-package list; any other package it is configured to fetch lands in other_packages so nothing is silently dropped.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-pi' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_pi, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-engram' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_engram, SUM(CASE WHEN key NOT IN ('gentle-pi', 'gentle-engram') THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS other_packages FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-pi' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_pi, SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'gentle-engram' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS gentle_engram, SUM(CASE WHEN key NOT IN ('gentle-pi', 'gentle-engram') THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS other_packages FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

panels.title: gentle-ai release downloads (cumulative per tag)
panels.description: Cumulative GitHub release asset download counts per tag, from the public GitHub API (api.github.com) — a public count, not telemetry from any gentle-ai install. Each bar is the latest known total for that tag, not a per-day delta. Matches GET /v1/summary's downloads.github.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS tag, r.value AS total_downloads FROM rollups_daily r INNER JOIN (SELECT key, MAX(day) AS max_day FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' GROUP BY key) latest ON latest.key = r.key AND latest.max_day = r.day WHERE r.metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' ORDER BY total_downloads DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.key AS tag, r.value AS total_downloads FROM rollups_daily r INNER JOIN (SELECT key, MAX(day) AS max_day FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' GROUP BY key) latest ON latest.key = r.key AND latest.max_day = r.day WHERE r.metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' ORDER BY total_downloads DESC

panels.title: Agents declared today
panels.description: Distinct installs seen today that declare each agent, live from the events table (json_each over agents_json). One install can declare several agents.

targets.queryText: SELECT je.value AS agent, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.agents_json) je WHERE e.event = 'install' AND e.received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY installs DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT je.value AS agent, COUNT(DISTINCT e.install_id) AS installs FROM events e, json_each(e.agents_json) je WHERE e.event = 'install' AND e.received_at >= CAST(strftime('%s', date('now')) AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY installs DESC
